body.statement: For every \(G\in\mathfrak D(V)\), the edgewise formulas define a unique finite \(\Gamma(G)\in\mathfrak D(V)\), and \(\operatorname{Prof}(\Gamma(G))=\operatorname{Prof}(G)\). In particular, no new internal bidirected edge or bidirected loop is inserted, every present bidirected loop remains present, and the directed-loop status of every singleton SCC is unchanged.
body.justification: It verifies that simultaneous saturation is a uniquely specified operation on the full finite-DMG universe.
body.gap: A simultaneous mixed saturation needs an invariant profile theorem for every inserted edge, including directed-loop and bidirected-loop cases.
body.consumer: The fixed-profile theorem can quantify over one exact realizable family and one well-defined greatest member.
